title: Hand of Straights
statement: Return true when you can rearrange `hand` into groups of `group_size` consecutive values. Each card is used once.
hints: If the length is not divisible by the group size, return false.
Count the cards. Always start a group at the smallest remaining value.
A group starting at x consumes one of x, x+1, ..., x+group_size-1. If any is missing, return false.

approaches.name: Sort and scan
approaches.explanation: A counter plus a sorted unique list.

editorial: The smallest remaining card has nowhere to sit except as the start of a group. That greedy choice is forced. Consume the next group_size - 1 consecutive values. Repeat until the counter is empty or a hole appears.

examples.explanation: The length is not divisible by 4.
